name: ec021a75-b0a0-4d88-90d9-1d39556bee7a
description: Rapid Response Monitoring voice agent: cancels false alarms and places branches on test after passcode verification. All customer data is mocked in-code (demo).

variableDeclarations.name: _resolved_account
variableDeclarations.description: JSON-serialized object describing the account the agent is acting on (account_id, branch_name, street_address, account_last_digits, has_active_alarm, dispatch_status, passcode_verified). Populated by lookup/verify tools during the conversation; never set directly in evals.

variableDeclarations.name: caller_phone
variableDeclarations.description: Caller's phone number supplied by the telephony platform (or eval); key into the mock account dataset via lookup_accounts_by_caller. Drives single- vs multi-account branching.

variableDeclarations.name: _caller_accounts
variableDeclarations.description: JSON-serialized list of the caller's full mock account records (including private fields like passcode and dispatch_status), written by lookup_accounts_by_caller as the single source of mock data for downstream tools. Tool-derived; never set directly in evals and never referenced in instructions or returned to the model.

variableDeclarations.name: _language
variableDeclarations.description: Active conversation language ('English' or 'Spanish'), written by set_language only when the caller explicitly asks to switch. Defaults to English (the conversation always starts in English). Read by the after_model callback to pick the farewell language; tool-derived, never set directly in evals.
